text:
IncidentBot: [P1] Alert -> HelixHealth (enterprise VPC / dedicated pool dp-east-2) reporting missing traces and sparse metrics for tenant-342. Automatic paging to #incidents and oncall.

Sasha: saw the page. quick triage Qs: is this traces only or logs/metrics too? any frontend errors from the customer?

Amy: customer says traces show up in app-level logs but nothing in our tracing UI. metrics (span counts) dropped to near 0 for tenant-342 around 08:12 UTC. Logs exist in the forwarder host (they provided syslog snippets).

Mike: I'm oncall. taking ownership — will start with forwarder health and index ingestion pipeline. Sasha, can you watch the tracing indexer?

Sasha: watching. initial hypothesis: tenant-level routing key mismatch in the per-tenant forwarder -> indexer handshake. I've seen this when a dedicated pool upgrade changed the tenant header mapping.

Lee: pinging infra team to check dp-east-2 network policies. sometimes VPC egress rules block OTLP -> indexer after config drift.

DeployBot: Deploy started: rolling restart forwarder-service/dp-east-2 (by Sasha) at 08:26 UTC.

Mike: running commands now to tail forwarder logs:

```
kubectl -n redwood logs svc/forwarder-dp-east-2-0 --since=15m | grep tenant-342 | tail -n 50
```

Mike: logs show front-end batches arriving and successful forward attempts, but indexer responses are 403 for tenant 342: `403 Forbidden - tenant mapping invalid`.

Sasha: that matches mapping-break. check the tenant mapping config in the dedicated pool: `/etc/forwarder/tenant_map.yml` — maybe the tenant id was canonicalized during a migration.

Amy: raising with customer: "we see your spans arriving at our edge, but they're not being accepted by the indexer. we've started mitigation steps and will update in 15m." customer acknowledged.

Raj: I can patch a temporary allowlist on the indexer to accept tenant-342 while we fix mapping. Will need owner approval for bypass. @Sasha can you confirm tokens/tenant headers are safe to accept bypass?

Sasha: if we do bypass, do it as a scoped, timeboxed change and log everything. use `indexer-allowlist` with reason `incident-2470012345-helix`.

Mike: agreed. Raj, please proceed but follow the runbook section "temporary-tenant-allowlist". I'm documenting steps in the thread.

Raj: Applying allowlist now (ETA ~2m).

```
# adhoc: add tenant-342 to allowlist
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://indexer.internal/api/v1/allowlist \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant-342","expires_in":"2h","reason":"incident-2470012345"}'
```

Raj: done. indexer returned 200. starting a small replay probe from forwarder.

Mike: replay probe shows traces flowing in. I can see span ingestion for tenant-342 increasing.

Amy: letting HelixHealth know: "we see traces returning to the UI, we're monitoring for completeness. temporary allowlist applied; we'll follow with permanent mapping fix." 

Lee: infra confirms there was a config drift during a pool config push at 07:58 UTC — tenant_map.yml lost an alias line for tenant-342. rollback to previous config would also fix it but that would affect other tenants. patching mapping is safer.

Sasha: I'll generate the correct tenant_map patch and open a PR to dp-east-2 config repo. Patch will add canonical id and alias entries for tenant-342. After review and a small canary apply, we should remove the allowlist.

Mike: Amy, can you keep customer updated and ask them for a couple of sample trace IDs (if they still have them) so we can verify end-to-end linking after the patch?

Amy: asked, they provided 3 trace IDs. sharing privately in DM.

Raj: creating a short-lived dashboard to monitor span counts and trace latency for tenant-342. link: https://console.internal/d/txn/tenant-342 (internal only)

DeployBot: Rolling restart completed for forwarder-service/dp-east-2 at 08:34 UTC. No restarts failed.

Mike: monitoring shows baseline return to ~95% of expected span count within 4 minutes of allowlist. traces are now visible for sample IDs.

Sasha: PR opened: `dp-east-2/tenant-map#472` with patch and tests. tagging Raj for staged apply. Will coordinate canary to one indexer shard.

Raj: applying canary patch to shard-3 now. watching metrics.

Lee: infra will keep VPC monitoring on for the next hour to check for any egress flaps.

Mike: ok summarizing: root cause = config drift removed alias for tenant-342 during pool config push; symptom = indexer denying spans (403) -> traces missing. Mitigation = temporary allowlist + forwarder restart + canary tenant_map patch. Customer impact = traces unavailable for ~22 minutes (08:12-08:34) but app metrics/logs unaffected.

Amy: customer confirmed they can now see traces and appreciate quick response. they requested a post-incident writeup.

Sasha: once canary looks good (30m), we'll remove the allowlist and finish roll-out. please add a follow-up to infra runbook to add a lint step to prevent missing alias lines during config pushes.

Mike: agreed. tagging for postmortem: Sasha (eng-runtime), Raj (eng-platform), Lee (infra), Amy (CS). I'll keep this thread open and update status.

Raj: mitigation verified. allowlist scheduled for automatic removal in 2h; I will proactively remove it after roll-out if everything stable. :white_check_mark:

Mike: closing incident in 2h unless regressions. good job team. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Incident P1 -> status: mitigated (temporary workaround applied). oncall: Mike. tickets: INC-2470012345 created.
